items.rationale: Section 2.3.3 requires atmospheric causation and fire-group cover; the reported surge alone does not establish either. If those conditions and fixed installation under §4.2.2 are confirmed, §§7.1.9–7.1.10 allow €1,413 gross for one like-for-like unit; this wording has no kitchen-location exclusion.

Under §§7.1.1(b), 7.1.11 and 9.5, installation follows the covered replacement, with €480 gross for one ordinary installation. If the line also includes work on other equipment, only the allocable covered share is payable.

Under §§7.1.5, 7.1.7 and 7.1.9–7.1.10, €61 gross is reasonable for one equivalent console if the prior one was damaged or could not be refitted after necessary removal. The description confirms a console mount, but not damage to the prior console or inability to reuse it.
Under §7.1.11, ordinary freight follows the covered replacement, estimated at €43 gross for one shipment. Any freight attributable to noncovered equipment must be apportioned out.
